nodes.summary: For every prime $p$, the number of integers $r$ with $1 \le r \le p - 1$ such that neither $16r + 1$ nor $8r + 1$ is a square modulo $p$ equals $\lfloor p/4 \rfloor$.
nodes.title: Residues $r$ with $16r + 1$ and $8r + 1$ both non-squares modulo $p$

nodes.summary: For every prime $p$, let $N$ be the number of integers $r$ with $1 \le r \le p - 1$ such that neither $12r + 1$ nor $8r + 1$ is a square modulo $p$. Then $N = \lfloor p/4 \rfloor - 1$ if $p \equiv 5 \pmod{24}$, $N = \lfloor p/4 \rfloor + 1$ if $p \equiv 11 \pmod{24}$, and $N = \lfloor p/4 \rfloor$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Residues $r$ with $12r + 1$ and $8r + 1$ both non-squares modulo $p$

nodes.summary: For $n \ge 0$, $c_8'(n)$ is the number of partitions of $n$ into distinct even parts plus the sum, over $m = 1, \dots, n$, of the number of partitions of $n$ in which every even number $2i$ with $1 \le i \le m$ is a part, every even part at most $m$ appears at most twice, every odd part at most $m$ appears exactly once, and every part greater than $m$ is even and appears exactly once.

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 0$ and let $x$ be an integer with $0 \le x < 2^{2k+1}$, where the exponent $2k - 2$ is truncated at $0$. Then $x$ is a square modulo $2^{2k}$ but not a square modulo $2^{2k+1}$ if and only if $x = 2^{2k} + 2^{2k-2}$.
nodes.title: Residues that are squares modulo $2^{2k}$ but not modulo $2^{2k+1}$

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 0$ and let $x$ be an integer with $0 \le x < 2^{2k}$, where the exponents $2k - 1$ and $2k - 2$ are truncated at $0$. Then $x$ is a square modulo $2^{2k-1}$ but not a square modulo $2^{2k}$ if and only if $x = 2^{2k-1}$ or $x = 2^{2k-1} + 2^{2k-2}$.
nodes.title: Residues that are squares modulo $2^{2k-1}$ but not modulo $2^{2k}$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
